headline: NASA’s Curiosity rover found a ‘sea of polygons’ on Mars
summary: Curiosity rover discovered a vast field of honeycomb-shaped polygons on Mars. These polygonal fractures, 1.5-3 inches wide, were found in Valle Grande. This is the largest such formation observed by the rover to date.

headline: Google DeepMind’s new AI model can control a robot’s entire body
summary: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2 now controls full humanoid robot bodies. The updated AI model supports movements from feet to fingertips. Previous versions focused only on upper-body robot control.

headline: ABC demands FCC drop its ‘punitive’ early license renewal of its stations
summary: ABC filed formal opposition to the FCC's move for early license renewal. The network labels the FCC's effort as 'punitive' and aimed at chilling broadcaster speech. ABC charges the agency is trying to force premature renewals on its stations.

headline: Google is working on Chrome updates that don’t require restarts
summary: Google is developing 'dynamic patching' to eliminate Chrome restarts for updates. This new approach aims to make bug fixes and updates less disruptive. The goal is to provide seamless browser updates without interrupting user sessions.

headline: How a Skyrim Username Error Left an Innocent Man to Serve 18 Months in Jail
summary: An innocent Canadian man spent 18 months in prison due to a typo. Wisconsin police misspelled his Skyrim-inspired internet username. This clerical error led to his wrongful incarceration.

headline: The Elder Scrolls Online Content Delayed to 2027 Following Xbox Layoffs
summary: The Elder Scrolls Online's future content is now delayed until 2027. This setback is a direct result of recent Xbox layoffs. Development plans for the game have been significantly impacted.

headline: Valve Says Steam Machine Reservations Will Be Filled By End of 2026
summary: Valve expects to fulfill all Steam Machine reservations by the end of 2026. This indicates a long waiting period for customers. The company is working through existing orders for the hardware.

headline: Neon Genesis Evangelion Is Coming to Criterion Channel in September
summary: The legendary anime 'Neon Genesis Evangelion' will stream on Criterion Channel. Hideaki Anno's iconic series is set to arrive this September. Fans can soon access the acclaimed show through the platform.

headline: European nations to boycott World Cup if Fifa goes ahead with investment plan
summary: UEFA's 55 member associations threaten to boycott the World Cup. This move is in protest against FIFA's plan to sell stakes in its competitions. European nations are united in opposing FIFA's investment strategy.

headline: Thousands evacuated in Crete as wildfires threaten tourist resorts
summary: Thousands have been evacuated in Crete due to raging wildfires. Strong winds are fanning the flames in the Rethymno region. Tourist resorts on the Greek island are now under serious threat.

headline: Drought declared across whole of Wales as conditions 'deteriorate'
summary: A drought has officially been declared across the entirety of Wales. The country is experiencing its driest July on record in nearly 190 years. Water conditions are rapidly deteriorating amidst the prolonged dry spell.

headline: Greens review social media operation as Polanski row rumbles on
summary: The Green Party is reviewing its social media strategy following a controversy. This comes after a contentious post by its leader regarding Roman Polanski. The party is grappling with internal fallout from the incident.
